findings.title: Missing idempotency key in webhook call
findings.body: The webhook handler calls `record_payment` without the new `idempotency_key` parameter, so the idempotency check is bypassed. This can lead to duplicate payments when the provider retries the same event. Pass the idempotency key from the event data to `record_payment`.

summary.problem: The idempotency key is not passed from the webhook handler to the recording function, breaking the new idempotency logic.
summary.done_well: The recording function now implements idempotency via `find_by_key` and avoids duplicate payments.
